reviews.title: Camera verification won’t work
reviews.text: I do love this app. It’s helped me cut my screen time down drastically. But randomly, the camera to verify I did my quest stopped working. I disabled access to my camera and gave access back. Didn’t work. I deleted the app, redownloaded and signed back in, still didn’t work. It still showed the interface of the camera, but there wasn’t anything that the camera was picking up. Just black. Whats dumb though is my camera app works just fine. It’s only on this app that it doesn’t work for some reason. It’s kinda hard to complete quests and have access to my phone when the camera literally won’t work on this app.

reviews.title: Actually succeeds at feeling like a game
reviews.text: love this app. literally makes me get up n do stuff, and really feels like a video game, which not many apps can pull off. Only thing I think could be better is the crown system. There’s not a lot you can do with crowns, and they stack up way faster than i spend them. I think it’d be cool if there was a way to spend them on skins for the app or maybe like unlocking certain functions, like 250 crowns = 1 custom sidequest or something like that.

reviews.title: Subscription needed/Not Free
reviews.text: You need to pay $50/year or $10/month in order to use it for longer than the week trial. It’s kinda of useless too, if you’re going to workout, you’re going to workout, this won’t change that. It’s just a waste of money for an app to tell you to do what you’re already going to do. If you wanna use your phone less cause you feel bad about it, just learn something from your phone so you don’t feel so bad or condition yourself to put your phone down for 5 seconds every time you pick it up so you aren’t just instantly going to some app without thinking about it, or look up some other strategies. Anyway, main review, this app’s useless.

reviews.title: Longer form side quests?
reviews.text: This app seriously helps me when I need to get off my phone but I don’t know what to do. It gives me simple tasks. I probably won’t be featured on the Instagram but if the developers see this I would suggest adding longer form side quests. Something that could get you out the house more instead of being able to do something from inside your room. And even though there are a few, I believe adding things like go on a hike or walk 1 mile would boost productivity even more. Something that takes actual doing to complete. Thank you.
